name: Howl A/G Studio
tagline: We put the fun in games
pitch: We're a small independent studio making games that would bring fun and life to any genre of games especially "Horror" and "Action" game.
story:
We are a indie team who absolutely love deep lore,
captivating visuals, and
engaging mechanics that keep
me coming back for more. For
us, it’s the entire experience
of us trying to build a community and watching them react to our game either positively or negatively. Our mission is simple: to
seek out pure, high-quality
entertainment and also trying to be a Double or Triple A studio.
